subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which core contract should own durable subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: extend task/audit/artifact/session-control, create a dedicated subagent lifecycle API, or defer this to narrower timeline/channel issues?
rationale: The remaining work sets a public persistence, Gateway protocol, and operator-control boundary with security and compatibility consequences that should not be selected by automation.

options.title: Extend Existing Ledgers
options.body: Use task_runs, subagent_runs, audit events, artifacts, and session-control as the canonical surface, adding only the missing receipt and supervision fields/actions.

options.title: Create Dedicated Lifecycle API
options.body: Add a separate subagent lifecycle receipt API if maintainers want stronger separation from task summaries and audit logs.

options.title: Defer To Narrower Issues
options.body: Keep this issue as design backlog and implement only channel-specific liveness or timeline slices in narrower canonical reports.

recommendation.title: Extend Existing Ledgers
recommendation.body: Use task_runs, subagent_runs, audit events, artifacts, and session-control as the canonical surface, adding only the missing receipt and supervision fields/actions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent control and registry-lifecycle history is closest to the cancel/steer/resume ownership choice.
